title: Stock Analyzer - Stock Market Analysis Tool
description: The Stock Analyzer project is a comprehensive stock market analysis tool that leverages machine learning models to help users gain insights into stock performance. It allows users to input stock symbols, select specific date ranges, and explore historical stock trends through interactive visualizations. The platform fetches real-time stock data, processes it, and displays key trends, making it easier for users to analyze past performance and identify patterns in price movements.

title: Student Results Analysis Dashboard
description: Built and deployed an interactive web-based dashboard to analyze the academic results of the Data Science department across all years and semesters. The project enables dynamic filtering by batch, year, semester, and section. It provides subject-wise performance insights, pass/fail analysis, top performers, and departmental trends using visualizations. The dashboard was built using Streamlit, containerized with Docker, and deployed via Render for public access.
technologies: Python, Pandas, Plotly, Streamlit, Docker, Git, Render

title: Descriptive Analysis of Cricket Player Stats – Virat Kohli
description: Conducted an analytical project focused on evaluating Virat Kohli’s cricket performance by web scraping data from ESPNcricinfo. where I analyzed various metrics such as batting averages, strike rates, and performance across different formats. This detailed analysis provided insights into his consistency, strengths, and key trends in his career, offering a deeper understanding of his performance over time.
technologies: pandas, Numpy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Jupyter Notebook and Data Scraping tools

title: Unemployment Analysis case study
description: Conducted an Unemployment Analysis project where I utilized data science techniques to analyze trends and key factors affecting unemployment. The project involved data collection, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis (EDA). I developed predictive models to forecast future unemployment rates and visualized the results through interactive charts.
technologies: pandas, Numpy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, scikit-learn, Jupyter Notebook and Power BI

title: Instructo - AI-Powered Personalized Learning Platform
description: Instructo is an AI-driven educational platform designed to enhance learning by generating personalized roadmaps and providing access to structured study materials. The platform focuses on advanced computer science topics, eliminating unnecessary concepts for an optimized learning experience.
